title: Reporting Utilization Scorecard — v1 Burden vs. v2 Minimalist Model
purpose: Measure the effectiveness of Framework v2's 4-report model. Framework v1 generated 1,227 files with 65% unconsumed. Framework v2 targets exactly 4 reports per session with >90% consumption. This scorecard tracks reduction progress and reporting compliance.

v1_reporting_burden.broadly_mentioned: 725 files (59.6% — mentioned in REVISION_HISTORY.md but not necessarily consumed as source material)

per_session_average.trend: INCREASING from ~3 to ~12 files/session over project lifetime

peak_session.note: S726 Phantom Baseline Remediation — highest single-session file output

duplication_analysis.certified_count: Appears in ~8 files per reporting session (~450 total appearances). Copied into DASHBOARD.json, SESSION_SUMMARY.md, PORTFOLIO_IMPACT_ANALYSIS.json, CERTIFICATION_RESULTS.json, FORECAST.json, GOVERNANCE_PRESERVATION_AUDIT.json, RISK_REGISTER.json, EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md.

consumption_classification.consumed_as_source: 432 files (35.5%) — directly referenced as data source by later sessions
consumption_classification.session_only: 380 files (31.2%) — referenced within their session only, no downstream use
consumption_classification.orphaned: 492 files (40.1%) — never referenced in any governance document
consumption_classification.retirement_candidates: ~800 files (65%) classified as one-off or orphaned

v2_reporting_model.target: 4 reports per session (hard cap at S910, soft cap ≤8 at S830)

reports.name: Readiness Report
reports.content: Session gate status, portfolio snapshot, session plan, mid-session drift check
reports.generation_trigger: Session T0 — after pre-flight scan pipeline completes
replaces_v1: Pre-flight scan result files (replaced by embedded scan data)
Portfolio snapshot files (merged from DASHBOARD.json + PORTFOLIO_IMPACT_ANALYSIS.json)
Session plan files (replaced by embedded prioritization)

reports.name: Quality Report
reports.content: Structural defect inventory, content quality assessment, EW integrity, per-item CAQS scores, difficulty distribution
reports.generation_trigger: After Quality Board completes review pass
replaces_v1: Per-agent quality output files (merged into consolidated verdicts)

reports.name: Certification Report
reports.content: Per-item CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE decisions, state transitions, evidence references, REVISION_HISTORY.md entry data

reports.name: Governance Report
reports.content: Session close authorization, portfolio safety, governance events, defect library updates, reporting compliance

v2_reporting_model.consumption_target: >90% (every v2 report has a defined downstream consumer — zero orphaned files)

retirement_categories: Individual agent outputs — ~120+ files (findings embedded into consolidated board verdicts)
Meta-reporting packages — reports about reports, zero downstream value
100-series incremental status logs — ~170 files, zero downstream reference
Pilot dry-run exports — 17 synthetic student files
Per-session non-milestone dashboards — consumed within session, then forgotten
One-off snapshot audits — consumed within session only
Legacy naming variants — inconsistent naming, zero traceability
Forecast duplicates — FORECAST + COMPLETION_FORECAST per session merged to single file
retention_types: Portfolio-level dashboards (*_DASHBOARD.json from milestone sessions only)

implementation_schedule.S830: Soft cap 8 enforced. Legacy files identified and moved to reports/legacy/. Reporting compliance first measured.
implementation_schedule.S900: Tightened to ≤6. Agent outputs no longer persisted as standalone files.
implementation_schedule.S910: Hard cap ≤4. All BF metrics at v2 targets. Retirement complete.

RP-001_reports_generated.formula: reports_generated = count of new report files created during session

RP-002_reports_consumed.metric: Reports Actively Consumed by Downstream Sessions
RP-002_reports_consumed.formula: reports_consumed = count of this session's reports referenced as data source by any subsequent session
RP-002_reports_consumed.v2_target: >90% (every v2 report has a defined consumer)

RP-003_reports_referenced.formula: reports_referenced = count of reports mentioned at least once in REVISION_HISTORY.md or downstream governance documents
RP-003_reports_referenced.v2_target: 100% (every v2 report is referenced — zero invisible files)

RP-004_reports_retired.formula: reports_retired = count of legacy files moved to reports/legacy/

retirement_progress.S830: All identified legacy files catalogued and tagged for retirement
retirement_progress.S910: All ~800 legacy files moved to reports/legacy/

RP-005_reporting_compliance.v2_target: 100% of sessions under the current phase cap (≤8 at S830, ≤6 at S900, ≤4 at S910)

measurements.notes: Reporting measurement baseline established. Retirement not yet begun.
